title: Brief
description: Plain-English actionable trading brief. Mirrors the Pydantic model in gui/brief.py:55-116 of the TradingAgents repo. The existing webapp validates against this shape on read; invalid briefs are silently dropped.

decision.description: The single-word verdict from the 5-tier rating scale.

action_plain.description: Plain-English action in 3-8 everyday words, layered on top of the canonical decision for readers who don't speak Overweight/Underweight. Optional.

tldr.description: 2-3 plain-English sentences leading with the action.

timeframe.description: How long the view is expected to hold (e.g. '4-6 weeks').

position_size.description: Recommended portfolio weight or sizing guidance.

entry_strategy.description: How to enter — lump sum vs scaled, with price targets.

stop_loss.description: Condition or price level to exit if thesis is wrong.

take_profit.description: Condition or price level to take profits / scale out.

action.description: Concrete action to take when the condition fires.

benchmark_view.description: One sentence on expected performance vs SPY over the timeframe.
